Comparison.heading: Why Clients Choose T1
Comparison.t1Feature1: End-to-end service from concept design to final installation with a single point of contact.
Comparison.t1Feature2: In-house manufacturing ensures precision, quality control and faster turnaround times.
Comparison.t1Feature3: European-grade materials sourced directly, cutting out middlemen and reducing costs.
Comparison.t1Feature4: Dedicated project manager assigned from day one through to handover.
Comparison.t1Feature5: Full after-sales support and warranty on all installed joinery and furniture.
Comparison.luxuryFeature1: High-end finishes and materials but often with limited customisation options.
Comparison.luxuryFeature2: Longer lead times due to overseas manufacturing and import logistics.
Comparison.luxuryFeature3: Premium pricing driven by brand markup rather than material value.
Comparison.luxuryFeature4: Multiple contractors involved, increasing risk of miscommunication.
Comparison.luxuryFeature5: After-sales service varies and is often handled by third parties.
Comparison.budgetFeature1: Lower upfront cost but limited material quality and design flexibility.
Comparison.budgetFeature2: Shorter warranty periods and reduced durability over time.
Comparison.budgetFeature3: Cookie-cutter designs with minimal bespoke or custom options.
Comparison.budgetFeature4: Installation managed externally with no dedicated oversight.
Comparison.budgetFeature5: Limited after-sales support; repairs and replacements at extra cost.

ProjectJourney.label: The T1 Project Journey
ProjectJourney.heading: From Vision to a Smarter, Beautifully Delivered Space
ProjectJourney.discoverDesc: We understand how you live, cook, work and entertain before defining the design, storage needs, budget and project timeline.
ProjectJourney.discoverAdvantage: Lifestyle-led consultation with one experienced design partner.
ProjectJourney.discoverHighlight: A solution designed around you — not selected from a catalogue.
ProjectJourney.innovateDesc: T1 creates intelligent layouts, concealed storage and multifunctional solutions that improve how every square metre performs.
ProjectJourney.innovateAdvantage: Smart space-saving innovation powered by Keller European engineering.
ProjectJourney.innovateHighlight: More storage, better functionality and greater freedom within the same space.
ProjectJourney.engineerDesc: Our designers, technical specialists and project managers coordinate drawings, specifications, manufacturing and installation requirements before work begins.
ProjectJourney.engineerAdvantage: European manufacturing precision combined with experienced local technical planning.
ProjectJourney.engineerHighlight: Fewer changes, less rework and greater certainty.
ProjectJourney.deliverDesc: We bring every detail together through precise execution, coordination, and quality control to deliver spaces exactly as envisioned.
ProjectJourney.deliverAdvantage: Seamless execution from concept to completion.
ProjectJourney.evolveDesc: We continue to optimize and adapt your space as needs change, ensuring long-term performance, flexibility, and value.
ProjectJourney.evolveAdvantage: Spaces that continue to perform and adapt.

Faq.q2: What types of spaces does T1 Studio design?
Faq.a2: T1 Studio designs and delivers kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, bathrooms, bedrooms, home offices and outdoor living spaces. We also handle full-home fit-outs and large-scale commercial and hospitality projects across the UAE.
Faq.q3: How long does a typical project take from consultation to completion?
Faq.a3: Project timelines vary depending on scope and complexity. A single room such as a kitchen or wardrobe typically takes 8–12 weeks from design sign-off to installation. Full-home and commercial projects are planned individually with a detailed schedule agreed at the outset.
Faq.q4: Do you offer after-sales support and warranty?
Faq.a4: Yes. Every T1 Studio project comes with a comprehensive after-sales package including a full warranty on all installed joinery and furniture, a dedicated point of contact for any post-handover queries, and scheduled follow-up visits to ensure your space continues to perform to the highest standard.
